implementation: Finite PLAY_MAAI.abilityId accepts only Cham ab01, Tia ab01 and Lancaster ab03; private maaiAbilityOptions validates current actor/hit, ownership, availability and spent attempt before payment.

Payment opens an ordinary cancellable AbilityFrame with a saved maai context. Success saves the hit election; canceled or unavailable ability leaves the paid ordinary maai. Both return through common physical reclaim before parent response progresses.

MaaiElection saves life, source action, original attacker and returned-counter provenance. Actual counter resolver changes its action kind to attack, so Lancaster uses the saved counter technique and resume parent rather than expecting kind defense.

Shared advance accounting uses submitted minus floor(advances/factor), factor two for selected live Cham/Tia and no advance cancellation for eligible Lancaster. Required physical advance count is shared across targets and rechecked after recovery. Existing carried maai is retained; each later hit starts fresh.
Tia retains one canonical ID for earth and maai contexts. A paid Flight against magic earth also cancels that hit, rather than treating the two clauses as separate abilities.
Physical payment retains its original source life even if the declaration finishes in a later life.

ReactionPanel offers a private default-off ability selector bound to the current window; MaaiDefenseSummary uses the same actual effective count and explains two advances or uncancelable maai without publishing hidden ability IDs.
canonicalEvidence: Cham and Tia actual bow defense: one maai survives one advance, two cancel it; decline remains ordinary.
Lancaster actual attack then actual returned counter: selected maai cannot be canceled. Ordinary incoming attack offers no such election and ordinary maai is canceled by one advance.
Actual Fate cancellation retains paid maai and reduces cancellation requirement to one advance.
Actual attacking Vanmil suppresses Tia after the first paid advance; no refund, no second payment, original damage applies.
Actual Ramba two-target Earth Spear with unequal elections uses each advance once for both targets.
Actual Griffin next hit resets election and advances.

Actual CHANT and later dedicated Shin Heavenly Hundred Strikes, with actual hit-count die three, reaches the second simultaneous hit with both target submissions/effective counts and shared advances reset. Final body damage respects one defended hit and all other actual hits.
Foreign source/actor rejected unchanged; all Engine steps JSON replay and conserve 220 unique physical cards.
